target.obligation: test whether currently exposed compare/contents reads can substitute for an exact frozen-head tree denominator

observations.surface: GitHub fetch_file at repository root, frozen ref
observations.detail: Directory path is rejected rather than enumerated; this independently reproduces the existing blocker.

The endpoint verifies root-to-head ahead_by=544 and returns a changed-files projection for the comparison. By contract and semantics this is a diff view, not the complete frozen-head tree identity set; it can include removals and cannot prove presence/identity of all unchanged head entries.

anti_goodhart_guard: Do not convert a large changed-files list into apparent tree coverage. Only a complete recursive tree/archive/clone identity surface with completeness evidence may close the obligation.
